description:
Music video directed and animated by hmng for the song Mou Sukoshi dake by YOASOBI.

Note: The song featured in this music video is also used as the theme song to the Fuji television program "Mezamashi TV". There also exists two versions of this video; the first being a Japanese version uploaded on November 21, 2021 and an English version of the song titled "Just a Little Step" also by YOASOBI, which was uploaded on November 28, 2022.
